quests.title: The Second Stillness
quests.journal: Catnap in Cypress shore.

lines.offer: Last time we sat still together. This time, sleep. A nap in the cypress shade. I'll keep watch. Badly, probably.
lines.done: You slept, and the roots grew a little. Neither of you tried.

quests.title: Map Party
quests.journal: Identify 10 Little Briar species in the book.

lines.offer: We want our map to have fish on it! Real ones! Can your book show ten kinds from Little Briar?
lines.done: I drew a frog in the corner. It's a friendly frog.

quests.title: Lantern Watch
quests.journal: Record Old Lantern.

lines.offer: When I was small, I saw a fish under the landing glowing like a lamp. Old Lantern. Nobody believes me but Grandmother. Find him?
lines.done: Gold. Just as gold as I remembered. Thank you for not laughing.

quests.title: Paint the Queen
quests.journal: Anchor in Lily cove for 30 game minutes while it's misty.

lines.offer: Wait with me in the lily cove in the mist? I want to paint the moment before she rises.
lines.done: No queen today, and I painted the mist anyway. It's the best one I've done.

quests.title: Birdhouse Row
quests.journal: Visit Cypress shore, South rocks and Creek inlet.

lines.offer: Three birdhouses, three snags, and I've built them all. I just can't stay awake long enough to deliver them. Would you?
lines.done: Wrens moved in already. Fastest tenants I've ever had.

quests.title: Swim Buddy
quests.journal: Travel 200 m in Open water.

lines.offer: Paddle alongside me across the open water? Everyone else just stares.
lines.done: See? Perfectly normal. Here, a little thing I think about while floating.

quests.title: Rainy-Day Ears
quests.journal: Anchor anywhere on Little Briar for 30 game minutes while it rains.

lines.offer: Confession: I hate rain on my ears. Could I shelter under your boat next time it rains?
lines.done: Dry ears! You're a hero. Have my old swim cap. It's lucky.

quests.title: Heron Clock
quests.journal: Bot scouts South rocks.

lines.offer: The herons tell the hour by the rocks. Have your Bot look at the south rocks and tell me what he sees.
lines.done: Herons stand there when the shade's just so. That's three o'clock. Told you.

quests.title: A Loon for Gus
quests.journal: Visit Big open water on Flathead, then tell Gus.

lines.offer: I heard there are loons up north. Haven't heard a loon since I was young. If you ever go, listen for me?
lines.done: You heard one? (quiet) Thank you. Take the bell; I don't ring it anymore.

quests.title: Taste Test
quests.journal: Catch any fish on dough balls.

lines.offer: New recipe. Will fish eat it? Take a dozen, put it on a line, tell me honestly.
lines.done: They ATE it?! I'm putting it in the shop.

quests.title: Cookout Bread
quests.journal: Attend the Sunday cookout at Briar Landing.

lines.offer: Sunday cookout, I'm bringing bread. Come eat some so I'm not the only one.
lines.done: You came! Here, a loaf-shaped buoy. It floats better than my real bread.

quests.title: Practice Buoys
quests.journal: Pass the 4 practice buoys in order in Clear Creek coves.

lines.offer: My practice buoys are in the sheltered cove. Follow them at your own pace, round and back.
lines.done: Lovely line! You've got whisker-sense for open water. Have my whistle.

quests.title: Squeak Test
quests.journal: Use the Wave Chime on Cedar Creek.

lines.offer: Is the duck squeaking right? Ring the chime somewhere on Cedar and tell me if the fish complain!
done: HA! A fish came up! HA!

quests.title: The Last Verse
quests.journal: Witness the Whiskered Guardian.

lines.offer: If you ever see the Guardian, tell me how it looked. Then I'll have my last verse.
lines.done: Its whiskers wrote the twilight on the water. There. Finished. Keep this copy.

quests.title: Cedar Census
quests.journal: Identify 20 Cedar Creek species in the book.

lines.offer: I'm compiling a census of Cedar. Help me reach twenty species? I'll name the next one after you. Kidding. After my aunt Beatrix.
lines.done: Twenty! Take my old notebook, every page has a fish and an aunt.

quests.title: Treasure Tour
quests.journal: Visit Flooded shoreline, Dam riprap and Creek channels, then talk to Patch.

lines.offer: Treasure hunt! Flooded shoreline, dam riprap, creek channels. Then come back and I'll tell you what I found.
lines.done: Found it! My lucky spoon! …You keep it. You were luckier for me than it ever was.

quests.title: Night Line
quests.journal: Premium or heavy line · Chicken liver · Creek channels · 60 active minutes, then check it.

lines.offer: Set a good line in the creek channels with liver and leave it an hour. Let's see if you've got the patience. I don't, these days.
done: Not bad. Not bad at all.

quests.title: Believe Me
quests.journal: Record the Channel Leviathan.

lines.offer: Catch the Leviathan. Then nobody can tell me I dreamed it.
lines.done: (long pause) I'm not crying. Take my lantern. I won't need proof anymore.

quests.title: Under the Pecans
quests.journal: Catch 3 fish in Flooded shoreline.

lines.offer: My pecan trees shade the flooded shoreline. Catch three fish under them so I know they're useful.
lines.done: Shade AND fish. Good trees.

quests.title: Pie for Everyone
quests.journal: Attend the Sunday cookout at Cedar Landing.

lines.offer: Sunday I'm bringing pie to the cookout. You'll come? You won't ask for the recipe?
lines.done: You didn't ask! You're my favorite. Here's a charm, not the recipe.

quests.title: Lamps on the Pool
quests.journal: After 7 pm, pass the 3 lamp buoys around the Marked Pool in order.

lines.offer: Ride with me around the three lamp buoys tonight. I like company while I check them.
lines.done: All three bright. The pool is happy.

quests.title: Lullaby
quests.journal: Record the Spillway Monster.

lines.offer: I sing to the big blue every night. I would love to see who I've been singing to.
lines.done: (humming) There you are, big one. Thank you, Skipper. Keep the old lamp glass.

quests.title: Ranger Check
quests.journal: Visit Upper lake flats, Clear Creek coves and Caney Creek landing.

lines.offer: Ranger check: visit the flats, the coves and the landing, and say 'all clear' at each! I'm practicing!
done: All clear, all clear, all clear! You're a natural.
(she tips her paddleboat in the shallows, laughing)

quests.title: Badge Day
quests.journal: Standard or better line · Nightcrawlers · Upper lake flats · 60 active minutes, then talk to Kit.

lines.offer: Last badge! I have to teach someone a whole fishing line. Set one on the flats with worms and let it soak an hour, then show me!
lines.done: I'M A RANGER! You get my practice badge. You earned it too.

quests.title: The Deep Lantern
quests.journal: In the Glacial trench, set a line inside the cold layer and check it.

lines.offer: Old Silverhead lives where the cold is. Set a line down in it in the trench. Your little sub can find it.
lines.done: Good. The cold remembers. Here's how to make Huckleberry's mash; Silverhead likes it.

quests.title: Silverhead
quests.journal: Record Old Silverhead.

lines.offer: Show me Silverhead before I really retire.
lines.done: Still there. Still silver. Take my old depth weight; I'll fish shallower now.

quests.title: Snow Light
quests.journal: Anchor in Snowmelt inlet for 30 game minutes during snow mist.

lines.offer: Wait with me in the snowmelt inlet next time the snow mist comes. Mist makes the best light.
lines.done: Look at that. I forgot my lens cap, and it's still the best photo I've taken.

quests.title: The Phantom
quests.journal: Record the Glacial Phantom.

lines.offer: Find the Phantom. I want one picture. Just one.
lines.done: Got it. And look, I got you in the frame too. Keep this one.

quests.title: Field Test
quests.journal: Catnap in Gravel flats.

lines.offer: Nap on the gravel flats and tell me if you were cozy. Science!
lines.done: Cozy? I knew it. It's me that's the problem.

quests.title: Cocoa Science
quests.journal: Cook any dish.

lines.offer: Cook something warm and tell me about it. That's also science.
lines.done: Data recorded: soup works. Take a mitten. I have nine.

quests.title: Models from Life
quests.journal: Identify 8 Flathead species in the book.

lines.offer: Bring eight Flathead fish into your book. I carve from what you've seen, not from stories.
lines.done: Good shapes. Very good shapes.

quests.title: The Burbot Figure
quests.journal: Catch a burbot.

lines.offer: The burbot is the hardest to carve. Show me one.
lines.done: Ah. It's all chin. Lovely. Here's a trout I made you.

quests.title: Back They Go
quests.journal: Catch a bull trout (it is always released).

lines.offer: If you catch a bull trout, you'll see it go right back. That's the rule here, and it's a good one. Catch one, and watch it swim off.
lines.done: There it goes. Letting it go is how we keep it.

quests.title: Owl Count
quests.journal: Anchor in Gravel reefs for 2 game hours.

lines.offer: Sit with me on the gravel reefs a while. I lose count when I'm alone.
lines.done: Fourteen owls. Best count all year. Take a feather. I found it, I didn't take it.

quests.title: Uncle's Stories
quests.journal: Talk to Captain Huckleberry on 3 different days.

lines.offer: Listen to the whole Whopper story. All three parts, on three days. I'll know if you skip.
lines.done: You heard it all. The boot part's true, you know. I was there.

quests.title: The Whopper
quests.journal: Record Huckleberry's Whopper.

lines.offer: Catch the Whopper. Prove him right. Please.
lines.done: IT'S REAL! (composes himself) I mean. Obviously. Take the tin cup; he drinks from it when he tells it.

quests.title: Larch Gold
quests.journal: Catch 3 yellow perch.

lines.offer: Catch three perch for my basket supper, they're the color of larch!
lines.done: Gold fish for a gold week!

quests.title: Outpost Supper
quests.journal: Attend the Sunday cookout at Glacial Peak Outpost.

lines.offer: Come to the outpost supper on Sunday! I'll weave you something while we talk!
lines.done: There! A needle basket, I made it while you ate, I'm slow but I'm chatty.

quests.title: Big Open
quests.journal: Travel 400 m in Big open water.

lines.offer: Ride the big open water with me. Let the wind do the work.
lines.done: Yeehaw. Quietly.

quests.title: Trout Trail
quests.journal: Catch 4 different trout species.

lines.offer: Four kinds of trout. That's a proper trail.
lines.done: Now that's a trail. Wear this pennant on your boat.

quests.title: Cold Layer
quests.journal: Use the Thermocline Scanner on Flathead.

lines.offer: Can your Bot measure the cold layer here? I want my map to match the water.
lines.done: There's the floor you can't see. Perfect.

quests.title: Two Lakes, One Layer
quests.journal: Use the Thermocline Scanner on Crater Caldera.

lines.offer: Sora says the caldera has a cold layer too. Same physics, different lake. Measure it?
lines.done: Two lakes, one law. Here's my rock hammer; I have a spare in sweater two.

quests.title: Warm Water
quests.journal: Line with ember grubs in Thermal springs, 60 active minutes, then check it.

lines.offer: Set a line near the warm springs with ember grubs. If the fish come, the guests will too.
lines.done: Warm water, happy fish. I'll put the lanterns up again.

quests.title: The Old Bather
quests.journal: Record the Caldera Fire-Lizard.

lines.offer: Find the old bather. I want to know it's well.
lines.done: A salamander! Of course. Take a token; it can bathe for free.

quests.title: Glass Shore
quests.journal: Bot scouts Obsidian cliffs.

lines.offer: Send your Bot along the obsidian cliffs! Tell me what he sees!
lines.done: SEE?! Glass!

quests.title: Black Glass
quests.journal: Record the Obsidian Gar.

lines.offer: (whisper) Catch it. Then tell me loudly.
lines.done: IT'S SO SHINY!! Take a bead from the shore.

quests.title: Fog Cocoa
quests.journal: Anchor on Pumice shelf for 30 game minutes during fog.

lines.offer: Wait with me in the next fog on the pumice shelf. I'll make two cups.
lines.done: (sip) Perfect. Don't tell the fog.

quests.title: Mineral Cup
quests.journal: Cook Cobalt Mineral Broth.

lines.offer: Sora makes a mineral broth. Cook it? I want to try a savory cup.
lines.done: Savory cocoa. I've made a terrible mistake and I love it. Take the mug.

quests.title: Pumice Float
quests.journal: Visit Pumice shelf, Obsidian cliffs and Drowned pines.

lines.offer: Pumice floats! Want to see where it washes up? Shelf, cliffs, drowned pines!
lines.done: Floating stone. Still amazes me.

quests.title: Stone Tour
quests.journal: Visit South rocks on Little Briar, Dam riprap on Cedar Creek and Gravel reefs on Flathead.

lines.offer: I want a rock from every lake. Go look at the rocky spots on Briar, Cedar and Flathead for me?
lines.done: You remembered all of them! I won't. Keep this pocket stone.

quests.title: Moss Lanterns
quests.journal: Anchor in Moss gardens for 2 game hours.

lines.offer: Sit with me in the moss gardens while I light the lanterns. It takes a while. That is the point.
lines.done: All lit. One for you.

quests.title: Night Friends
quests.journal: Catch 3 different species at night on Crater Caldera.

lines.offer: I make a lantern for each friend. Catch three kinds of night fish here, so I know your colors.
lines.done: Your lantern. It suits you. (sneeze) Ha!

quests.title: Lookout Loop
quests.journal: Travel 500 m in Caldera open.

lines.offer: Do a lookout loop across the open caldera! Report anything big!
lines.done: Report: everything is big. Good job.

quests.title: All Clear
quests.journal: Finish chapter 4, then talk to Ember.

lines.offer: Is the fog marker fixed? Sora won't tell me. Fix it and tell me!
lines.done: ALL CLEAR! Take my binoculars, I have, um, a spare pair. My eyes.

quests.title: The Poem
quests.journal: Anchor in Drowned pines for 30 game minutes during fog, then talk to Mist.

lines.offer: (whisper) My poem is about the fog. Wait in it with me, among the drowned pines. Then I'll read it.
lines.done: Something warm walks under the cold, / carrying a lamp it was never told about. / I hear it more than see it, / and I don't mind.

quests.title: Hide-Away
quests.journal: Catch a fog mudminnow.

lines.offer: There's a minnow that hides in fog too. Hide-away. Find one for me?
lines.done: (whisper) there it is. Take the poem; I know it by heart.

quests.title: Clear Water
quests.journal: Anchor in Caldera open for 30 game minutes while it's clear.

lines.offer: On a clear day the water's so still it shows the sky. Wait in it with me?
lines.done: See? The sky lies down on the water. I knew it.

quests.title: I Told You So
quests.journal: Finish chapter 5, then talk to Juno.

lines.offer: You went IN the reflection? Come tell me everything.
lines.done: I told everyone. I TOLD them. Take my chart, you'll use it more than me.

quests.title: Clear Keepers
quests.journal: Catch a Lahontan cutthroat (it is always released).

lines.offer: If you catch a Lahontan, it goes right back, and you'll see why. They're rare here. Catch one and let it go.
lines.done: Back home it goes. Clear water is a lot of small kindnesses.

quests.title: Clear Count
quests.journal: Identify 15 Crater Caldera species in the book.

lines.offer: Help me count what lives here. Fifteen kinds in your book.
lines.done: Fifteen. The water's in good paws. Wear this pin.

quests.title: Drift Lines
quests.journal: Line in Astral current, 60 active minutes, then check it.

lines.offer: Set a line in the astral current and check it after an hour. Watch how far it drifts. Data!
lines.done: Drifted. Of course. But you tied it well.

quests.title: Hold Fast
quests.journal: Use the Zero-G Winch.

lines.offer: When you've a winch, hold a line in the current. I want to see the knot hold.
lines.done: Old knot, new winch. Perfect. Take my star-knot.

quests.title: Star-Chimes
quests.journal: Anchor in Astral current for 2 game hours.

lines.offer: Sit with me in the current while I practice? Two hours. I'm less nervous with a friend.
lines.done: I played the whole thing! Here, the Weaver's favorite bait. Moon-milk on stardust.

quests.title: The Dance
quests.journal: Record the Nebula Weaver.

lines.offer: Find the Weaver while I play?
lines.done: It DANCED. Take a chime. Play it badly; it likes that.

quests.title: Comet Stream
quests.journal: Travel 400 m in Comet stream.

lines.offer: Race me up the comet stream! Well, travel. Travel me!
lines.done: You WIN. Or I won. Everyone wins!

quests.title: Comet Nap
quests.journal: Catnap in Comet stream.

lines.offer: Nap with me by the stream. I nap the hardest.
lines.done: (waking) …I won the nap. Take a ribbon.

quests.title: Light-Reed String
quests.journal: Catch any fish in Light-reeds.

lines.offer: Catch a fish in the light-reeds. Where there are fish, there are good reeds for strings.
lines.done: Perfect reed. Hear it hum?

quests.title: Station Song
quests.journal: Attend the Sunday cookout at Cosmic Drift Station.

lines.offer: Station supper on Sunday. I'll play. You'll listen and pretend you hate it.
lines.done: You tapped your paw. I SAW it. Take a string.

quests.title: Edge of the Map
quests.journal: Visit Nebula open, Void well, Astral current and Light-reeds.

lines.offer: Help me find the edges: the open, the deep, the current and the reeds.
lines.done: No edge. It just goes on, gently. I like that.

quests.title: Star Census
quests.journal: Identify 10 Starlight Nebula species in the book.

lines.offer: Ten kinds of fish for my chart's border, please. It's a decorative border.
lines.done: Gorgeous border. Take my compass; it points to friends, which is you.

quests.title: Moon Garden
quests.journal: Cook Moon-Milk Pudding.

lines.offer: Cook Astra-9's moon pudding? I'll grow something from the spoon.
lines.done: A sprout! An actual sprout!

quests.title: Sun and Moon
quests.journal: Catch a solar sunfish and a lunar loach.

lines.offer: A sun fish and a moon fish, for the garden's two halves.
lines.done: Day and night, both in bloom. Take a moon-flower.

quests.title: Tell Me About Frogs
quests.journal: Catch any fish in Lily cove on Little Briar, then talk to Andi.

lines.offer: Catch a fish in a lily cove down there and tell me about it. Especially the frogs.
lines.done: They SING? Frogs SING?

quests.title: Frog Day
quests.journal: Wearing the Frog shell, set the Reed Anchor in Light-reeds.

lines.offer: Can your Bot be a frog? Can it frog in the light-reeds? Please?
lines.done: RIBBIT! I drew you a picture.

quests.title: Count the Lights
quests.journal: Catch 3 purrsec lanternfish.

lines.offer: Help me count? Catch three and I'll count them twice.
lines.done: Three! Then three more is six! Then it's lots again.

quests.title: The Edge-Sitter
quests.journal: Catch an event-horizon goby.

lines.offer: There's a goby that sits right at the edge of the deep. I've never reached it. Could you?
lines.done: The Edge-Sitter! Take my crook. I'll herd with my paws.

quests.title: Slow Sail
quests.journal: Travel 300 m in Astral current.

lines.offer: Sail the astral current with me, slowly. Teach me.
lines.done: I saw a star I've passed a thousand times. Today it waved.

quests.title: Burst
quests.journal: Catch a supernova salmon.

lines.offer: One last fast thing: the Supernova salmon. It only bites for the patient. Funny, right?
lines.done: Patient AND fast. Take a sail patch.

quests.title: The Long Story
quests.journal: Talk to Captain Huckleberry on 3 different days.

lines.offer: Ho-ho! Got the patience for a long story? Come by now and then, and you'll hear the whole Whopper.
lines.done: Ho-ho! You heard the whole thing! Nobody ever stays for all of it. Here, for your patience.

quests.title: Fog Names
quests.journal: Anchor anywhere on Crater Caldera for 30 game minutes during fog, then talk to Sora.

lines.offer: Every fog here has a name. Wait in one, and tell me how it felt. I'll tell you what it's called.
lines.done: That one is Bartholomew. He's shy. He liked you.

quests.title: Units, Please
quests.journal: Identify 5 Starlight Nebula species in the book.

lines.offer: Teach me your units, Skipper. Catch five kinds of fish here and tell me their sizes in your 'feet'.
lines.done: Feet! Fish have no feet! I love it.

day: Welcome back, dear. The kettle's on and the coves are quiet.
Ah, {BotName}. Your collar's crooked. There. Better.
greetings.weather:drizzle: A good soaking for the lines. Come under the porch roof.
greetings.weather:mist: Mist on the lilies. That's when the shy ones come out.
greetings.after_ch5: There's my author. What did the lake tell you today?
greetings.cookout: Everyone's here! Sit, sit. Bring a fish if you like. Bring yourself regardless.

greetings.first: Ahoy, Skipper! Welcome to Doc's Lonely Star Marina! What can I get your rig?
greetings.day: Wind's off the main channel today. Read it with your whiskers, then check my gauges.
greetings.weather:drizzle: Rain's good for catfish and bad for my knees!
greetings.after_ch2: Marked Pool's busy. Folks say a Skipper found it. Wonder who.

greetings.day: Peace upon your bow, Skipper. The water reflects the clouds without holding them.
greetings.friend: Ah, my napping colleague. The dragonflies asked after you.

letters: Dear Skipper, the dragonflies are back. My tail says hello. — Moss

greetings.friend: Skipper! Life jacket? Yes! Good! Hi, {BotName}! Hi, frog-Bot!
The moon's good tonight, Skipper. I'm not scared of the landing anymore. Mostly.
Look, another heron. I'm going to paint it. Don't judge me.
(yawning) Oh, Skipper. I was just resting my eyes. For an hour.

greetings.day: Hello! Don't mind me, I'm swimming. Cats can swim, you know. Some of us adore it.
greetings.friend: Water's lovely today! Come in! No? Fine, I'll swim by your boat.

day: Afternoon. Ferried cats across this lake forty years. Never once lost.
greetings.friend: There's my loon-listener.

greetings.day: Fresh dough balls! Don't drop crumbs. Please don't drop crumbs.
greetings.friend: Skipper! Crumb check. …Clean. Wonderful.
There's my best student. Slow and pretty, Skipper.
Skipper! I built a silent winch! It's… mostly silent!
Skipper, I've been very quiet all morning. Three whole minutes.
Hello, colleague. Aunt Beatrix says hello. She's a drum.
Skipper! Found three lures and a sock today. Want the sock?

greetings.day: Hmph. Evening.
greetings.friend: Evening, Skipper. Look at that sunset. (sniff) Wind again.

letters: Skipper. Saw a good sunset. Thought of you. Wind's fine. — H.

greetings.day: Hi, sugar! Want a pecan? I have nine hundred.
greetings.friend: Sugar! Pecan? Still nine hundred.

greetings.day: Good evening. The pool is calm and the edges are lit. Fish here safely.
greetings.friend: Skipper. The pool says hello. In a very deep voice.

letters: The big one sang back last night. Truly. — Luz

greetings.day: Junior Ranger Kit! Life jacket check! …Pass!
greetings.friend: Ranger Kit reporting! Life jacket? Good! Me? …Also good! Probably!

greetings.day: Evening. I'm retired. Don't tell anyone you saw me out here.
greetings.friend: Out again. Retired again. Hello.

greetings.day: Shh. The light's nearly right. …No. Gone. Hello!
greetings.friend: Hold still! …Lens cap. Again. Hi!

greetings.day: (shivering) This sleeping sack is rated for very cold. I am testing whether I am.
greetings.friend: Hello! I'm wearing four layers! It's going great!

greetings.day: I carve fish. Show me fish.
greetings.friend: Hello. That is a big talk for me.

greetings.day: Evening, angler. Counting owls. Seven. Eight. Hello.
greetings.friend: (mouth full) Huckleberries? No. What huckleberries.

greetings.day: My uncle's Huckleberry. Don't ask him about the Whopper. …You asked him, didn't you.
greetings.friend: Uncle says you're in four of his stories now.

greetings.day: Hello-hello! The larches are going gold, it's my favorite week, have you got a minute, I've got many.
greetings.friend: Hello-hello! Guess how many baskets. More.

greetings.day: Howdy. Mighty fine wind. Tied my hat down twice.
greetings.friend: Howdy, partner. Wind says hi.

greetings.day: (three sweaters) I study glaciers. I'm fine. I'm toasty.
greetings.friend: Fourth sweater today. It's for science.

greetings.day: Welcome to the bathhouse. Do not splash. I'm only half joking.
greetings.friend: Skipper. Come in. Carefully.

greetings.day: HELLO! Have you seen the cinder isle?! The shore is GLASS!
greetings.friend: SKIPPER! (whisper) Hi.

greetings.day: Cocoa? It's better on foggy mornings. I hate foggy mornings.
greetings.friend: Two cups ready. Fog or no fog.

greetings.day: Hold this rock. No, this one. Where did I put the other one?
greetings.friend: I found a rock. It was in my pocket. Was it yours?

greetings.day: Good evening. Welcome. (sneeze) Ha! Excuse me.
greetings.friend: Your lantern is still lit. I checked.

greetings.day: I'm the lookout. Official. My dad says I'm a lookout, but I'm the lookout.
greetings.friend: Lookout Ember! You're cleared to fish.

greetings.day: (whisper) hello… (enormous sneeze) …sorry.
greetings.friend: (whisper) hello again.

greetings.day: (yawning) Is it night yet? I'm an astronomer. I keep missing it.
greetings.friend: I stayed up for the stars! …Fell asleep at eight.

day: Mind your wake near the shore, please. Clear water is everyone's.
greetings.friend: Hello! Ignore the paws.

greetings.day: Good evening, fellow engineer. Your deckhand has an excellent chassis.
greetings.friend: Colleague! And colleague's Skipper!

greetings.day: Oh! An audience. (drops a chime) Hello.
greetings.friend: (confidently) Hello! (drops chime)

greetings.day: ZOOM! Hi! Bye! Hi!
greetings.friend: Zoom! (I'm sleepy.)

greetings.day: Harp music! Do you like harps? You're wrong, you do.
greetings.friend: Admit it. You hum my songs.

greetings.day: I chart the Lagoon. Don't look down; I get dizzy.
greetings.friend: Hello. Don't look down. I'm fine. I'm looking up.

greetings.day: My moon garden! It's… well, it's mostly moon.
greetings.friend: Two sprouts now! A record!

greetings.day: Are you from the lakes below? Is it true there are FROGS?
greetings.friend: Frog report, please!

letters: I drew 40 frogs. Are they right? (They have stars on, for fun.) — A

greetings.day: These are my lanternfish. One, two, three… lots.
greetings.friend: Lots and lots of lanternfish today!

greetings.day: Fastest sail in the sky. Hello. I'd like to stop being that.
greetings.friend: Hello, slowly.

greetings.day: Ho-ho! Warm your paws by the stove! I've got a story, it's short, I promise.
greetings.weather:snow_mist: Snow mist! The trout love it. My whiskers don't.
greetings.after_ch3: Used your note this morning. You saved me a very long story!

story: Did I tell you about the Whopper? Longest burbot in the world. It ate my boot.
The Whopper, part two: it returned my boot. Polished. I'm not making this up.
Last part: I saw it again on the gravel reefs, snowy night, roe on the hook. It winked. You'll see.
letters: SKIPPER! New story. It's long. Come hear it. — Huck

greetings.day: Skipper. The water is deep and calm today. What will you look for?
greetings.weather:fog: This fog is called Marguerite. She's slow but kind.
greetings.weather:clear: Clear. You can see sixty feet down. Don't let it make you dizzy.
greetings.after_ch4: My chart has no gaps now. I keep looking at where the gap was.

day: Salutations! Today's currents are glowing at forty-two… purples. Is purple a unit?
greetings.weather:aurora: Aurora tide! Everything's biting! Including my curiosity!
greetings.after_ch5: I've stopped surveying on Tuesdays. I've seen three new things.

lines.greeting: Ahoy, Skipper! Forty years on riverboats, and you know what I learned? Slow turns win.
lines.offer: Take a long, easy run across the open water with me. Your own pace. I want to see how you hold a line.
